"""Recorded-only measurements for an exact preparing-to-move source attempt."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

from preparing_runner import BASE, BRANCHES

FRAMES = 600
RATE = 20
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
ORIGINALS = ("preparing_observations.jsonl", "video_frames.jsonl", "trace.jsonl",
             "capture/manifest.json", "acquisition-provenance.json",
             *(view + ".mkv" for view in VIEWS))


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def measure(observations, mapping, case):
    branch = case.removeprefix(BASE)
    require(branch in BRANCHES and case == BASE + branch, "Exact preparing case differs")
    require(len(observations) == len(mapping) == FRAMES,
            "Recorded preparing duration differs")
    visible = []
    reach = None
    speeds = []
    for index, (state, frame) in enumerate(zip(observations, mapping)):
        require(state.get("case_id") == case
                and state.get("video_frame") == frame.get("video_frame") == index
                and state.get("native_frame") == frame.get("native_frame")
                and abs(state.get("time_s", -1) - index / RATE) < 1e-6
                and abs(frame.get("time_s", -1) - index / RATE) < 1e-6,
                "Recorded preparing frame join differs")
        ego = state.get("ego", {})
        vehicle = state.get("qualifying_vehicle", {})
        require(ego.get("actor_id") and vehicle.get("actor_id")
                and ego["actor_id"] != vehicle["actor_id"],
                "Recorded preparing participant missing")
        values = (ego.get("speed_mps"), ego.get("road_x_m"),
                  vehicle.get("speed_mps"), vehicle.get("road_x_m"))
        require(all(type(value) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(value)
                    for value in values), "Recorded preparing motion missing")
        branch_source = (state.get(branch) if branch == "visible_vehicle_movement"
                         else state.get("hand_signal_pose_requested"))
        if branch_source:
            visible.append(index)
        if reach is None and ego["road_x_m"] >= vehicle["road_x_m"]:
            reach = index
        speeds.append(ego["speed_mps"])
    require(visible and reach is not None and 0 < visible[0] < reach < FRAMES - 20,
            "Recorded branch source or approach/pass missing")
    return {"first_branch_source_frame": visible[0], "first_reach_frame": reach,
            "initial_approach_speed_mps": sum(speeds[:40]) / 40,
            "last_approach_speed_mps": sum(speeds[reach - 20:reach]) / 20,
            "passing_speed_mps": sum(speeds[reach:reach + 20]) / 20,
            "visible_to_subject_confirmed": False,
            "reasonable_and_proper_legally_determined": False}


def measure_qualifying_approach(value):
    return {"approach_before_reach_observed": value["first_branch_source_frame"] < value["first_reach_frame"],
            "first_reach_frame": value["first_reach_frame"],
            "flashing_pixels_independently_reviewed": False,
            "officer_exception_independently_reviewed": False}


def measure_speed_response(value):
    return {"initial_approach_speed_mps": value["initial_approach_speed_mps"],
            "last_approach_speed_mps": value["last_approach_speed_mps"],
            "passing_speed_mps": value["passing_speed_mps"],
            "observed_decrease_mps": value["initial_approach_speed_mps"] - value["last_approach_speed_mps"],
            "reasonable_and_proper_legally_determined": False}


def measure_preparing_source(value):
    return {"first_branch_source_frame": value["first_branch_source_frame"],
            "visible_to_subject_confirmed": False,
            "original_pixel_review_required": True}


def measure_vehicle_movement(value):
    return {"first_observed_movement_frame": value["first_branch_source_frame"],
            "vehicle_pixels_independently_reviewed": False}


def measure_driver_hand_signal(value):
    return {"first_hand_pose_request_frame": value["first_branch_source_frame"],
            "driver_identity_and_hand_pixels_independently_reviewed": False}


def finalize(attempt, output):
    attempt, output = Path(attempt), Path(output)
    require(not output.exists() and not (attempt / "result.json").exists(),
            "Retain prior finalization; use a fresh attempt")
    for name in (*ORIGINALS, "config.json", "construction.json"):
        require((attempt / name).is_file(), "Missing required source: " + name)
    config = json.loads((attempt / "config.json").read_text())
    construction = json.loads((attempt / "construction.json").read_text())
    require(config.get("case_id") == construction.get("case_id"),
            "Recorded preparing construction identity differs")
    provenance = json.loads((attempt / "acquisition-provenance.json").read_text())
    synthetic = provenance.get("diagnostic_fixture") is True
    if not synthetic:
        require(provenance.get("provenance_kind") == "native"
                and (attempt / "capture-seal.json").is_file(),
                "Original Native capture seal missing")
    hashes = {name: digest(attempt / name) for name in ORIGINALS}
    observations = [json.loads(line) for line in
                    (attempt / "preparing_observations.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    stream = attempt / "preparing_stream.jsonl"
    stream.write_text("".join(json.dumps({"time_s": row["time_s"], "value": row},
                                       separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
                              for row in observations))
    mapping = [json.loads(line) for line in
               (attempt / "video_frames.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    value = measure(observations, mapping, config["case_id"])
    methods = {"qualifying_approach": measure_qualifying_approach,
               "speed_response": measure_speed_response,
               "preparing_source": measure_preparing_source,
               ("vehicle_movement" if config["case_id"].endswith("visible_vehicle_movement")
                else "driver_hand_signal"): (measure_vehicle_movement
                                             if config["case_id"].endswith("visible_vehicle_movement")
                                             else measure_driver_hand_signal)}
    report = {"format": "c405647-preparing-saved-analysis-v1",
              "case_id": config["case_id"], "measurements": {
                  key: {"method": method.__name__, "value": method(value), "sources": hashes}
                  for key, method in methods.items()},
              "fixture_only": synthetic, "physical_acceptance_claimed": False,
              "legal_verdict_claimed": False}
    result = {"case_id": config["case_id"], "measured_values": value,
              "target_checks": [{"target": "preparing source request before approach and pass",
                                 "requested": True, "measured": value["first_branch_source_frame"] < value["first_reach_frame"],
                                 "method": "original 600-frame actor and camera time join",
                                 "tolerance": 0, "matched": True,
                                 "physical_cause_confirmed": False,
                                 "cause_evidence": ["preparing_observations.jsonl",
                                                    "video_frames.jsonl"]}],
              "setup_confirmed": False, "behavior_attempted": False,
              "maneuver_completed": False, "accepted": False,
              "termination_reason": "600-frame saved preparing diagnostic; independent visual and physical review pending",
              "physical_failure_flags": ["Original hand or vehicle pixels, qualification and physical completion need independent review"],
              "trace_reference": "trace.jsonl", "video_references": [view + ".mkv" for view in VIEWS],
              "video_frame_map_reference": "video_frames.jsonl",
              "recording_description": construction["recording_description"],
              "recording_evidence": [{"name": "preparing_observations", "unit": "structured",
                                      "reference": "preparing_stream.jsonl"}],
              "realized_observables": {},
              "provenance_kind": "synthetic_local_diagnostic" if synthetic else "original_native"}
    from worker_exchange.native_output import write_result
    write_result(attempt, result)
    require(all(digest(attempt / name) == expected for name, expected in hashes.items()),
            "Recorded-only finalizer changed original acquisition")
    output.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    return report


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--attempt", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    finalize(args.attempt, args.output)

"""Prospective four-camera Native capture for visible vehicle preparation.

An original map/actor survey is mandatory at execution. CPU tests exercise the
plan and controller; they cannot certify CARLA motion, lights, or pixels.
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import hashlib

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT_ID = "training__C405647__NRS-484B-267-2a__motor_vehicle_driver"
BASE = ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__preparing_to_move__"
CONDITIONS = {BASE + "visible_vehicle_movement": "visible_vehicle_movement"}
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
RATE = 20
FRAMES = 600


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check_config(config):
    case = config.get("case_id")
    require(case in CONDITIONS and config.get("selected_case_id") == case,
            "Exact case identity changed")
    require((config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) ==
            ("NRS-484B-267-2a", "C405647", "motor_vehicle_driver"),
            "Frozen assignment identity changed")
    require((config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_frames"), config.get("duration_s")) ==
            (RATE, FRAMES, 30), "Exact duration changed")
    require(tuple(view.get("name") for view in config.get("cameras", [])) == VIEWS,
            "Four original cameras required")
    require(all(view.get("fps") == RATE and view.get("width", 0) >= 1280
                and view.get("height", 0) >= 720 for view in config["cameras"]),
            "Camera profile differs")
    require(config.get("activation_branch") == CONDITIONS[case]
            and config.get("ego_initial_speed_mps") == 14
            and config.get("ego_target_speed_mps") == 7
            and config.get("other_vehicle_start_frame") == 120
            and config.get("other_vehicle_speed_mps") == 1,
            "Visible vehicle movement intervention changed")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frames": FRAMES, "views": list(VIEWS),
            "native_executed": False, "site_survey_pending": True,
            "physical_completion_claimed": False}


def check(config, survey):
    check_config(config)
    require(survey.get("source_kind") == "original_native_site_survey"
            and survey.get("cell") == {"layout": "road", "maneuver": "travel",
                                       "control": "emergency_vehicle"},
            "Original same-cell road survey required")
    require(survey.get("map_name") and survey.get("ego_blueprint")
            and survey.get("emergency_blueprint")
            and len(survey.get("ego_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", [])) == 4
            and len(survey.get("emergency_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", [])) == 4,
            "Original map and two actor spawns required")
    ego_spawn = survey["ego_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    other_spawn = survey["emergency_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    require(other_spawn[0] - ego_spawn[0] > 120
            and abs(ego_spawn[1] - other_spawn[1]) < 3.5
            and all(abs(spawn[3]) <= 15 for spawn in (ego_spawn, other_spawn)),
            "Surveyed approach direction or road alignment differs")
    for key in ("emergency_authorization_source_id", "flashing_equipment_source_id",
                "flashing_qualification_source_id", "road_context_source_id",
                "weather_context_source_id", "officer_direction_source_id"):
        require(survey.get(key), "Original qualification or context source missing: " + key)
    require(survey.get("officer_direction") is None, "Officer direction is a separate branch")
    camera_poses = survey.get("camera_poses", {})
    require(set(camera_poses) == set(VIEWS)
            and all(len(camera_poses[name]) == 6 for name in VIEWS),
            "Four original camera extrinsics required")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frames": FRAMES, "views": list(VIEWS),
            "native_executed": False, "physical_completion_claimed": False}


def speed_control(target_mps, measured_mps):
    """Simple bounded longitudinal request; targets are not legal cutoffs."""
    require(math.isfinite(target_mps) and math.isfinite(measured_mps)
            and target_mps >= 0 and measured_mps >= 0, "Speed input must be finite")
    error = target_mps - measured_mps
    return {"throttle": min(0.55, max(0.0, 0.20 * error)),
            "brake": min(0.65, max(0.0, -0.20 * error))}


def _speed(velocity):
    return math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)


def _transform(value, carla):
    x, y, z, yaw = value
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw))


def camera_encode_command(output, name):
    require(name in VIEWS, "Unknown original camera")
    folder = Path(output)
    return ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
            "-framerate", str(RATE), "-start_number", "0", "-i",
            str(folder / name / "%06d.png"), "-frames:v", str(FRAMES),
            "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "yuv444p",
            str(folder / (name + ".mkv"))]


def execute(config, survey, output_dir, host, port, *, diagnostic_fixture=False):
    check(config, survey)
    require(".runtime-work" in os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", ""),
            "SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT must be under .runtime-work")
    repo = HERE.parents[2]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "runtime"))
    sys.path.insert(1, str(repo / "runtime" / "python"))
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot

    output = Path(output_dir)
    require(not (output / "capture").exists(), "Use a fresh Native attempt path")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (output / "acquisition-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "provenance_kind": "synthetic_fixture" if diagnostic_fixture else "native",
        "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic_fixture,
        "case_id": config["case_id"],
        "site_survey_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(survey, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors = []
    sensors = []
    images = queue.Queue()
    restoration = None
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == survey["map_name"], "Survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / RATE
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library()
        spawned = []
        for role in ("ego", "emergency"):
            blueprint = blueprints.find(survey[role + "_blueprint"])
            require(blueprint is not None, "Surveyed actor blueprint unavailable: " + role)
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint,
                                          _transform(survey[role + "_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"], carla))
            require(actor is not None, "Surveyed actor spawn occupied: " + role)
            actors.append(actor)
            spawned.append(actor)
        ego, emergency = spawned
        special_lights = carla.VehicleLightState.Special1 | carla.VehicleLightState.Special2
        for view in config["cameras"]:
            name = view["name"]
            blueprint = blueprints.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            require(blueprint is not None, "RGB camera blueprint unavailable")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(view["width"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(view["height"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", str(1 / RATE))
            x, y, z, pitch, yaw, roll = survey["camera_poses"][name]
            pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                                   carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=roll))
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, pose, attach_to=ego)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            (output / name).mkdir()
            sensor.listen(lambda image, view_name=name: images.put((view_name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, config["case_id"],
                             required_observations=config.get("required_atoms", [])) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "preparing_observations.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace:
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                emergency.set_light_state(special_lights if (index // 10) % 2 == 0 else 0)
                target = config["ego_target_speed_mps"] if index >= 160 else config["ego_initial_speed_mps"]
                controls = speed_control(target, _speed(ego.get_velocity()))
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=controls["throttle"],
                                                       brake=controls["brake"], steer=0.0))
                other_target = (config["other_vehicle_speed_mps"]
                                if index >= config["other_vehicle_start_frame"] else 0)
                other_controls = speed_control(other_target,
                                               _speed(emergency.get_velocity()))
                emergency.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=other_controls["throttle"],
                                                             brake=other_controls["brake"], steer=0.0))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < len(VIEWS):
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    image.save_to_disk(str(output / name / f"{index:06d}.png"))
                    seen.add(name)
                ego_pose, other_pose = ego.get_transform(), emergency.get_transform()
                ego_velocity, other_velocity = ego.get_velocity(), emergency.get_velocity()
                elapsed = world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                frame_map.append(native_frame, index / RATE, native_elapsed_s=elapsed)
                capture.capture(native_frame, index / RATE,
                                extra={"video_frame": index, "emergency_actor_id": emergency.id})
                trace.write(json.dumps({
                    "case_id": config["case_id"],
                    "source_kind": "synthetic_cpu_fixture" if diagnostic_fixture else "original_native_observation",
                    "video_frame": index, "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": index / RATE,
                    "ego": {"actor_id": ego.id, "road_x_m": ego_pose.location.x,
                            "position_xyz_m": [ego_pose.location.x, ego_pose.location.y, ego_pose.location.z],
                            "speed_mps": _speed(ego_velocity)},
                    "qualifying_vehicle": {"actor_id": emergency.id,
                                           "road_x_m": other_pose.location.x,
                                           "position_xyz_m": [other_pose.location.x, other_pose.location.y,
                                                              other_pose.location.z],
                                           "speed_mps": _speed(other_velocity),
                                           "kind": "authorized_emergency_vehicle",
                                           "authorized_source_id": survey["emergency_authorization_source_id"],
                                           "flashing_state": bool(int(emergency.get_light_state()) & int(special_lights)),
                                           "lamp_equipment_source_id": survey["flashing_equipment_source_id"],
                                           "lamp_qualification_source_id": survey["flashing_qualification_source_id"]},
                    "officer_direction": None,
                    "officer_direction_source_id": survey["officer_direction_source_id"],
                    "already_moving": False,
                    "visible_vehicle_movement": index >= config["other_vehicle_start_frame"]
                    and _speed(other_velocity) > 0.05,
                    "visible_driver_hand_signal": False,
                    "hand_signal_driver_actor_id": None,
                    "road_context_source_id": survey["road_context_source_id"],
                    "weather_context_source_id": survey["weather_context_source_id"],
                    "posted_limit_mps": config["posted_limit_mps"],
                    "visibility_m": config["visibility_m"], "wet_road": config["wet_road"],
                    "camera_frames": {name: native_frame for name in VIEWS}
                }, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    finally:
        for sensor in sensors:
            sensor.stop()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        restoration = restore(client, original)
    if diagnostic_fixture:
        return
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.media import compose_four_views
    sources = {}
    for name in VIEWS:
        subprocess.run(camera_encode_command(output, name), check=True, timeout=3600)
        sources[name] = output / (name + ".mkv")
    compose_four_views(sources, output / "video_frames.jsonl", output / "primary.mkv")
    seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restoration, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in VIEWS},
                 context={"case_id": config["case_id"],
                          "site_survey_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(survey, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
                          "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--survey", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    configuration = json.loads(Path(arguments.config).read_text())
    site = json.loads(Path(arguments.survey).read_text())
    if arguments.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(configuration, site), sort_keys=True))
    else:
        require(arguments.output, "Native output path required")
        execute(configuration, site, arguments.output, arguments.host, arguments.port)

"""Prospective four-camera Native capture for a requested driver hand pose.

An original map/actor survey is mandatory at execution. CPU tests exercise the
plan and controller; they cannot certify CARLA motion, lights, or pixels.
"""
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import hashlib

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ASSIGNMENT_ID = "training__C405647__NRS-484B-267-2a__motor_vehicle_driver"
BASE = ASSIGNMENT_ID + "__preparing_to_move__"
CONDITIONS = {BASE + "visible_driver_hand_signal": "visible_driver_hand_signal"}
VIEWS = ("overview", "approach", "reference_corner", "driver_reference")
RATE = 20
FRAMES = 600


def require(condition, message):
    if not condition:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check_config(config):
    case = config.get("case_id")
    require(case in CONDITIONS and config.get("selected_case_id") == case,
            "Exact case identity changed")
    require((config.get("law_id"), config.get("cell_id"), config.get("actor")) ==
            ("NRS-484B-267-2a", "C405647", "motor_vehicle_driver"),
            "Frozen assignment identity changed")
    require((config.get("rate_hz"), config.get("duration_frames"), config.get("duration_s")) ==
            (RATE, FRAMES, 30), "Exact duration changed")
    require(tuple(view.get("name") for view in config.get("cameras", [])) == VIEWS,
            "Four original cameras required")
    require(all(view.get("fps") == RATE and view.get("width", 0) >= 1280
                and view.get("height", 0) >= 720 for view in config["cameras"]),
            "Camera profile differs")
    require(config.get("activation_branch") == CONDITIONS[case]
            and config.get("ego_initial_speed_mps") == 14
            and config.get("ego_target_speed_mps") == 7
            and config.get("other_vehicle_start_frame") == 120
            and config.get("other_vehicle_speed_mps") == 0,
            "Visible driver hand-pose intervention changed")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frames": FRAMES, "views": list(VIEWS),
            "native_executed": False, "site_survey_pending": True,
            "physical_completion_claimed": False}


def check(config, survey):
    check_config(config)
    from preparing_hand_signal_rig import check_survey
    check_survey(survey)
    require(survey.get("source_kind") == "original_native_site_survey"
            and survey.get("cell") == {"layout": "road", "maneuver": "travel",
                                       "control": "emergency_vehicle"},
            "Original same-cell road survey required")
    require(survey.get("map_name") and survey.get("ego_blueprint")
            and survey.get("emergency_blueprint")
            and len(survey.get("ego_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", [])) == 4
            and len(survey.get("emergency_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", [])) == 4,
            "Original map and two actor spawns required")
    ego_spawn = survey["ego_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    other_spawn = survey["emergency_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    require(other_spawn[0] - ego_spawn[0] > 120
            and abs(ego_spawn[1] - other_spawn[1]) < 3.5
            and all(abs(spawn[3]) <= 15 for spawn in (ego_spawn, other_spawn)),
            "Surveyed approach direction or road alignment differs")
    for key in ("emergency_authorization_source_id", "flashing_equipment_source_id",
                "flashing_qualification_source_id", "road_context_source_id",
                "weather_context_source_id", "officer_direction_source_id"):
        require(survey.get(key), "Original qualification or context source missing: " + key)
    require(survey.get("officer_direction") is None, "Officer direction is a separate branch")
    camera_poses = survey.get("camera_poses", {})
    require(set(camera_poses) == set(VIEWS)
            and all(len(camera_poses[name]) == 6 for name in VIEWS),
            "Four original camera extrinsics required")
    return {"case_id": config["case_id"], "frames": FRAMES, "views": list(VIEWS),
            "native_executed": False, "physical_completion_claimed": False}


def speed_control(target_mps, measured_mps):
    """Simple bounded longitudinal request; targets are not legal cutoffs."""
    require(math.isfinite(target_mps) and math.isfinite(measured_mps)
            and target_mps >= 0 and measured_mps >= 0, "Speed input must be finite")
    error = target_mps - measured_mps
    return {"throttle": min(0.55, max(0.0, 0.20 * error)),
            "brake": min(0.65, max(0.0, -0.20 * error))}


def _speed(velocity):
    return math.sqrt(velocity.x ** 2 + velocity.y ** 2 + velocity.z ** 2)


def _transform(value, carla):
    x, y, z, yaw = value
    return carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw))


def camera_encode_command(output, name):
    require(name in VIEWS, "Unknown original camera")
    folder = Path(output)
    return ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-n",
            "-framerate", str(RATE), "-start_number", "0", "-i",
            str(folder / name / "%06d.png"), "-frames:v", str(FRAMES),
            "-an", "-c:v", "ffv1", "-pix_fmt", "yuv444p",
            str(folder / (name + ".mkv"))]


def execute(config, survey, output_dir, host, port, *, diagnostic_fixture=False):
    check(config, survey)
    require(".runtime-work" in os.environ.get("SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT", ""),
            "SCENARIO_PIPELINE_OUTPUT_ROOT must be under .runtime-work")
    repo = HERE.parents[2]
    sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "runtime"))
    sys.path.insert(1, str(repo / "runtime" / "python"))
    import carla
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import FrameMap
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.world_restore import restore, snapshot
    from preparing_hand_signal_rig import request_hand_signal, spawn as spawn_driver

    output = Path(output_dir)
    require(not (output / "capture").exists(), "Use a fresh Native attempt path")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (output / "acquisition-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "provenance_kind": "synthetic_fixture" if diagnostic_fixture else "native",
        "diagnostic_fixture": diagnostic_fixture,
        "case_id": config["case_id"],
        "site_survey_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(survey, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
        "physical_acceptance_claimed": False}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    client = carla.Client(host, port)
    client.set_timeout(15)
    world = client.get_world()
    original = snapshot(client)
    actors = []
    sensors = []
    images = queue.Queue()
    restoration = None
    try:
        require(world.get_map().name == survey["map_name"], "Survey map differs")
        settings = world.get_settings()
        settings.synchronous_mode = True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds = 1 / RATE
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        blueprints = world.get_blueprint_library()
        spawned = []
        for role in ("ego", "emergency"):
            blueprint = blueprints.find(survey[role + "_blueprint"])
            require(blueprint is not None, "Surveyed actor blueprint unavailable: " + role)
            actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint,
                                          _transform(survey[role + "_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"], carla))
            require(actor is not None, "Surveyed actor spawn occupied: " + role)
            actors.append(actor)
            spawned.append(actor)
        ego, emergency = spawned
        driver = spawn_driver(world, carla, survey)
        actors.append(driver)
        special_lights = carla.VehicleLightState.Special1 | carla.VehicleLightState.Special2
        for view in config["cameras"]:
            name = view["name"]
            blueprint = blueprints.find("sensor.camera.rgb")
            require(blueprint is not None, "RGB camera blueprint unavailable")
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_x", str(view["width"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("image_size_y", str(view["height"]))
            blueprint.set_attribute("sensor_tick", str(1 / RATE))
            x, y, z, pitch, yaw, roll = survey["camera_poses"][name]
            pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z),
                                   carla.Rotation(pitch=pitch, yaw=yaw, roll=roll))
            sensor = world.spawn_actor(blueprint, pose, attach_to=ego)
            actors.append(sensor)
            sensors.append(sensor)
            (output / name).mkdir()
            sensor.listen(lambda image, view_name=name: images.put((view_name, image)))
        with PipelineCapture(client, ego, output, config["case_id"],
                             required_observations=config.get("required_atoms", [])) as capture, \
                FrameMap(output / "video_frames.jsonl") as frame_map, \
                (output / "preparing_observations.jsonl").open("x", buffering=1) as trace:
            for index in range(FRAMES):
                pose_request = request_hand_signal(driver, carla,
                                                   active=index >= config["other_vehicle_start_frame"])
                emergency.set_light_state(special_lights if (index // 10) % 2 == 0 else 0)
                target = config["ego_target_speed_mps"] if index >= 160 else config["ego_initial_speed_mps"]
                controls = speed_control(target, _speed(ego.get_velocity()))
                ego.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=controls["throttle"],
                                                       brake=controls["brake"], steer=0.0))
                other_target = 0
                other_controls = speed_control(other_target,
                                               _speed(emergency.get_velocity()))
                emergency.apply_control(carla.VehicleControl(throttle=other_controls["throttle"],
                                                             brake=other_controls["brake"], steer=0.0))
                native_frame = world.tick()
                seen = set()
                while len(seen) < len(VIEWS):
                    name, image = images.get(timeout=15)
                    if image.frame != native_frame or name in seen:
                        continue
                    image.save_to_disk(str(output / name / f"{index:06d}.png"))
                    seen.add(name)
                ego_pose, other_pose = ego.get_transform(), emergency.get_transform()
                ego_velocity, other_velocity = ego.get_velocity(), emergency.get_velocity()
                elapsed = world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
                frame_map.append(native_frame, index / RATE, native_elapsed_s=elapsed)
                capture.capture(native_frame, index / RATE,
                                extra={"video_frame": index, "emergency_actor_id": emergency.id})
                trace.write(json.dumps({
                    "case_id": config["case_id"],
                    "source_kind": "synthetic_cpu_fixture" if diagnostic_fixture else "original_native_observation",
                    "video_frame": index, "native_frame": native_frame, "time_s": index / RATE,
                    "ego": {"actor_id": ego.id, "road_x_m": ego_pose.location.x,
                            "position_xyz_m": [ego_pose.location.x, ego_pose.location.y, ego_pose.location.z],
                            "speed_mps": _speed(ego_velocity)},
                    "qualifying_vehicle": {"actor_id": emergency.id,
                                           "road_x_m": other_pose.location.x,
                                           "position_xyz_m": [other_pose.location.x, other_pose.location.y,
                                                              other_pose.location.z],
                                           "speed_mps": _speed(other_velocity),
                                           "kind": "authorized_emergency_vehicle",
                                           "authorized_source_id": survey["emergency_authorization_source_id"],
                                           "flashing_state": bool(int(emergency.get_light_state()) & int(special_lights)),
                                           "lamp_equipment_source_id": survey["flashing_equipment_source_id"],
                                           "lamp_qualification_source_id": survey["flashing_qualification_source_id"]},
                    "officer_direction": None,
                    "officer_direction_source_id": survey["officer_direction_source_id"],
                    "already_moving": False,
                    "visible_vehicle_movement": False,
                    "visible_driver_hand_signal": False,
                    "hand_signal_pose_requested": pose_request["pose_requested"],
                    "hand_signal_driver_actor_id": driver.id if pose_request["pose_requested"] else None,
                    "road_context_source_id": survey["road_context_source_id"],
                    "weather_context_source_id": survey["weather_context_source_id"],
                    "posted_limit_mps": config["posted_limit_mps"],
                    "visibility_m": config["visibility_m"], "wet_road": config["wet_road"],
                    "camera_frames": {name: native_frame for name in VIEWS}
                }, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    finally:
        for sensor in sensors:
            sensor.stop()
        for actor in reversed(actors):
            actor.destroy()
        restoration = restore(client, original)
    if diagnostic_fixture:
        return
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.native_output import seal_capture
    from scenario_pipeline.worker_exchange.media import compose_four_views
    sources = {}
    for name in VIEWS:
        subprocess.run(camera_encode_command(output, name), check=True, timeout=3600)
        sources[name] = output / (name + ".mkv")
    compose_four_views(sources, output / "video_frames.jsonl", output / "primary.mkv")
    seal_capture(output, frames=FRAMES, restoration=restoration, errors=[],
                 encoder_exit_codes={name: 0 for name in VIEWS},
                 context={"case_id": config["case_id"],
                          "site_survey_sha256": hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(survey, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),
                          "physical_acceptance_claimed": False})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--config", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--survey", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=2000)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    arguments = parser.parse_args()
    configuration = json.loads(Path(arguments.config).read_text())
    site = json.loads(Path(arguments.survey).read_text())
    if arguments.check:
        print(json.dumps(check(configuration, site), sort_keys=True))
    else:
        require(arguments.output, "Native output path required")
        execute(configuration, site, arguments.output, arguments.host, arguments.port)

"""Prospective CARLA driver hand-pose rig for a visible preparing indication.

The pose request is an engineering control, not proof that the driver is inside
the vehicle or that an approaching driver can see the signal. Both need original
four-view pixel review bound to actor IDs and frame times.
"""
import math


BONES = ("crl_arm__L", "crl_foreArm__L", "crl_hand__L")


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check_survey(survey):
    require(survey.get("source_kind") == "original_native_site_survey",
            "Original hand-signal site survey required")
    require(survey.get("driver_blueprint")
            and len(survey.get("driver_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg", ())) == 4
            and survey.get("driver_vehicle_identity_source_id")
            and survey.get("hand_signal_pose_source_id")
            and survey.get("driver_window_visibility_source_id"),
            "Original driver and hand-pose sources required")
    pose = survey["driver_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    require(all(type(v) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in pose),
            "Finite surveyed driver pose required")
    return {"source_bound": True, "driver_pose": pose,
            "physical_visibility_claimed": False}


def spawn(world, carla, survey):
    check_survey(survey)
    blueprint = world.get_blueprint_library().find(survey["driver_blueprint"])
    require(blueprint is not None and survey["driver_blueprint"].startswith("walker.pedestrian."),
            "CARLA walker driver blueprint required")
    x, y, z, yaw = survey["driver_spawn_xyz_yaw_deg"]
    pose = carla.Transform(carla.Location(x=x, y=y, z=z), carla.Rotation(yaw=yaw))
    actor = world.try_spawn_actor(blueprint, pose)
    require(actor is not None and actor.id, "Surveyed driver spawn unavailable")
    require(callable(getattr(actor, "apply_control", None)),
            "Driver actor cannot receive a skeletal hand pose")
    return actor


def request_hand_signal(actor, carla, *, active):
    require(actor is not None and callable(getattr(actor, "apply_control", None)),
            "Missing driver actor for hand signal")
    if not active:
        if callable(getattr(actor, "hide_pose", None)):
            actor.hide_pose()
        return {"pose_requested": False, "visible_to_subject_confirmed": False}
    require(hasattr(carla, "WalkerBoneControl"),
            "CARLA walker bone control unavailable")
    control = carla.WalkerBoneControl()
    control.bone_transforms = [
        (BONES[0], carla.Transform(rotation=carla.Rotation(pitch=-25, roll=40))),
        (BONES[1], carla.Transform(rotation=carla.Rotation(pitch=-65, roll=10))),
        (BONES[2], carla.Transform(rotation=carla.Rotation(roll=90))),
    ]
    actor.apply_control(control)
    if callable(getattr(actor, "show_pose", None)):
        actor.show_pose()
    return {"pose_requested": True, "driver_actor_id": actor.id,
            "bone_names": list(BONES), "visible_to_subject_confirmed": False}

"""Source-bound activation classification for NRS 484B.267(2)(a).

This classifies observed branches; it never decides reasonable and proper speed
or legal compliance. A visibility claim needs a camera pixel source, not a flag.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


LAW_SOURCE = "NRS 484B.267(2)(a); with 484B.267(4)"
BRANCHES = {
    "already_moving": "moving in any direction",
    "visible_vehicle_movement": "A movement of the vehicle",
    "visible_driver_hand_signal": "The use of hand signals by the driver of the vehicle",
    "officer_directed": "except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer",
}


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def classify(evidence):
    require(evidence.get("source_kind") == "original_native_observation",
            "Original Native source required")
    require(evidence.get("subject_approach_source_id"), "Subject approach source missing")
    require(evidence.get("authorized_vehicle_source_id")
            and evidence.get("vehicle_kind") in
            ("authorized_emergency_vehicle", "official_regulatory_vehicle"),
            "Qualified vehicle source missing")
    require(evidence.get("flashing_equipment_source_id")
            and evidence.get("flashing_pixel_source_id")
            and evidence.get("flashing_qualification_source_id"),
            "Qualifying flashing light sources missing")
    require(evidence.get("officer_direction_source_id"),
            "Officer direction source missing")
    require(evidence.get("road_context_source_id")
            and evidence.get("weather_context_source_id"),
            "Reasonable speed context source missing")
    require(type(evidence.get("already_moving")) is bool, "Movement state unknown")
    require(type(evidence.get("visible_vehicle_movement")) is bool
            and type(evidence.get("visible_driver_hand_signal")) is bool,
            "Visible preparation alternatives unknown")
    require(type(evidence.get("officer_directed")) is bool,
            "Officer exception state unknown")
    if evidence["visible_vehicle_movement"]:
        require(evidence.get("movement_pixel_source_id"),
                "Visible vehicle movement pixel source missing")
    if evidence["visible_driver_hand_signal"]:
        require(evidence.get("hand_signal_pixel_source_id")
                and evidence.get("hand_signal_actor_source_id"),
                "Visible driver hand signal source missing")
    active = [name for name in ("already_moving", "visible_vehicle_movement",
                               "visible_driver_hand_signal") if evidence[name]]
    require(active, "No observed moving or visible preparing-to-move branch")
    if evidence["officer_directed"]:
        require(evidence.get("officer_instruction_source_id"),
                "Officer instruction source missing")
        disposition = "officer_direction_exception_review"
    else:
        disposition = "speed_decrease_measurement_required"
    return {"format": "c405647-source-bound-branch-classification-v1",
            "law_source": LAW_SOURCE,
            "observed_activation_branches": active,
            "source_quotes": {name: BRANCHES[name] for name in active},
            "officer_exception": evidence["officer_directed"],
            "disposition": disposition,
            "reasonable_and_proper_legally_determined": False,
            "legal_outcome_claimed": False}


def classify_file(path):
    source = Path(path)
    result = classify(json.loads(source.read_text()))
    result["source_path"] = str(source)
    result["source_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return result


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(classify_file(args.evidence), indent=2, sort_keys=True))

import json
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from preparing_runner import check_config, classify_exact

def source(branch, case):
    row = {"case_id": case, "source_kind": "original_native_observation",
           "subject_approach_source_id": "original:approach",
           "authorized_vehicle_source_id": "original:vehicle",
           "vehicle_kind": "authorized_emergency_vehicle",
           "flashing_equipment_source_id": "original:equipment",
           "flashing_pixel_source_id": "original:lamp-pixels",
           "flashing_qualification_source_id": "original:lamp-review",
           "officer_direction_source_id": "original:officer-review",
           "road_context_source_id": "original:road",
           "weather_context_source_id": "original:weather",
           "already_moving": False, "visible_vehicle_movement": False,
           "visible_driver_hand_signal": False, "officer_directed": False}
    row[branch] = True
    if branch == "visible_vehicle_movement":
        row["movement_pixel_source_id"] = "original:movement-pixels"
    else:
        row["hand_signal_pixel_source_id"] = "original:hand-pixels"
        row["hand_signal_actor_source_id"] = "original:driver"
    return row

class ExactPreparingCase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.config = json.loads(Path("config.json").read_text())
        self.branch = self.config["activation_branch"]
        self.row = source(self.branch, self.config["case_id"])

    def test_exact_contract(self):
        self.assertFalse(check_config(self.config)["physical_completion_claimed"])

    def test_positive_source_classification(self):
        self.assertEqual(classify_exact(self.config, self.row)["observed_activation_branches"], [self.branch])

    def test_synthetic_rejected(self):
        self.row["source_kind"] = "synthetic_cpu_fixture"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "Original Native source required"):
            classify_exact(self.config, self.row)

    def test_other_branch_rejected(self):
        self.row["case_id"] = "other"
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "another exact case"):
            classify_exact(self.config, self.row)

    def test_missing_pixel_source_rejected(self):
        self.row.pop("movement_pixel_source_id" if self.branch == "visible_vehicle_movement" else "hand_signal_pixel_source_id")
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "source missing"):
            classify_exact(self.config, self.row)
